retrieved_synopses: Players find remains of Dark Justiciars in the Ketheric City and wonder what might have happened to them and what kind of armor are they wearing.

The party has come across a group of skeletons in the Ketheric City, all wearing the same distinctive dark uniform — the game identifies them as Dark Justiciars and their armour appears as in‑world items. On inspecting the remains the group (or PC) recognises Shar’s emblem on the fabrics, marking these as agents of the Dark Lady and tying the scene to a nearby Shar shrine. Wyll’s casual remark shows companions are present and engaged; if Shadowheart is in the party, this discovery would be personally significant given her ties to Shar. The player’s vow to find whoever killed them signals a desire to avenge or at least defend Shar’s reputation, but who (or what) did the killing is not shown on‑screen.
Player spots a rack of rusted Dark Justiciar arms and armour, abandoned for some time. Reactivity for clerics and paladins of Shar.

Shadowheart finds the remains of the Dark Justiciars and based on her level of knowledge will make a comment. All of them meant to build up anticipation for the Shar Temple. Can be triggered multiple times.
Party approaches the Shar Temple and notices the Dark Justiciar corpses.
context: You come across a group of skeletons all wearing the same dark uniform identified as Dark Justiciars; their armour and arms appear in‑world and can be inspected or looted. The fabrics bear the unmistakable emblem of Shar, tying the corpses to a nearby Shar shrine/temple. Companions react — Wyll makes a flippant remark in the scene, and if Shadowheart is in the party the discovery has extra personal weight. The party wonders who (or what) killed them and the player vows to find the killer, but the attack itself is not shown on‑screen.
